tasks.title: Nmap MSSQL Scan
tasks.description: Basic port and script scan to identify MSSQL instances.

tasks.title: Password Spraying (CME / NetExec)
tasks.description: Spray known user lists and custom wordlists against the MSSQL service.

tasks.title: Impacket MSSQL Client
tasks.description: Connect to the MSSQL instance. Append -windows-auth if using Windows credentials rather than native SQL logins.

tasks.title: Enable & Run xp_cmdshell
tasks.description: If you have sysadmin privileges, enable xp_cmdshell to execute system commands.

tasks.title: Hash Capture (xp_dirtree)
tasks.description: Force the SQL server to authenticate to your Kali machine to capture the service account's NTLM hash via Responder.
